career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but relying on one skill throughout a career. Crew members with multiple skills, intelligent-system knowledge, and emergency capability become more valuable during the technology transition.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risks are military status and mission hazards. Roles depend on military staffing, and skills have limited transferability after service. Uncrewed aircraft and automated onboard systems reduce some positions, while people remain essential for mission coordination, emergencies, and real-time judgment. Versatile crew members receive greater emphasis.
risks: High mission risk and safety pressure
Intense training and mission demands
Roles depend on military staffing; transition requires reskilling
Uncrewed aircraft replace some mission types
Conflict between family life and military schedules

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can generate load manifests and assist with system checks, but the person who reports an airborne abnormality immediately remains the most reliable safeguard. Mission success and safe return depend on every crew position, coordination that machines cannot replace.

responsibilities: Load, unload, and deploy mission payloads
Monitor onboard equipment and cabin conditions

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「单技能吃到底」——多技能、懂智能系统、能应急的机组成员，在智能化转型期反而更受重视。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「编制属性和任务风险」——岗位依附军队编制，转业后技能迁移有限；无人机与自动化机载系统在减少部分机位，但空中任务的人员协同、应急处置和临场判断靠人，复合型机组成员更受重视。
risks: 任务风险高，安全压力大
训练与任务强度大
岗位依附编制，转业需转型
无人机替代部分任务类型
家庭生活与军旅节奏冲突

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能自动生成载荷清单、辅助系统检查，但空中任务里那个「第一时间汇报异常」的人，永远是最稳的保险丝。任务打得赢、飞得回，靠的是舱内每一个战位的人——这份协同，机器替代不了。

career_path_block.说明: High professional standards and substantial income variability

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but consumption cycles. Bar business follows the economy and drinking habits, but bartenders who turn guests into regulars continue to earn repeat business.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI but the income structure. Base pay is generally low, with much of earnings coming from tips or commission. Bar business is highly sensitive to economic cycles and consumption habits, so slow periods reduce income directly.
risks: Income depends on tips or commission and fluctuates sharply during economic downturns
Evening and weekend work disrupts normal sleep schedules
High social demands require continuous emotional energy
Robotic bars reduce standardized production roles
Prolonged standing strains the back, legs, and throat

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can remember recipes, pour drinks, and calculate inventory, but bartenders uniquely judge what a guest wants tonight and what words will help them relax.

responsibilities: Take orders and provide bar service

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「消费周期」——酒吧生意跟着经济和消费习惯走，但能把客人变成熟客的调酒师，永远不缺回头客。
career_risk_cards.fact: 最大的风险不是 AI，而是「收入结构」：基本工资普遍不高，收入大头靠小费或提成，酒吧生意受经济周期和消费习惯影响大，生意差的时候收入缩水最直接。
risks: 收入依赖小费/提成，经济下行波动大
晚班与周末工作，作息昼夜颠倒
社交耗能高，需要持续情绪输出
机器人吧台压缩标准出品岗位
长期站立，腰腿和咽喉压力大

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能记配方、能倒酒、能算库存，但「这位客人今晚想喝点什么、此刻什么话能让他放松」——这个对人的判断，永远是调酒师的。

career_risk_cards.callout: A safety engineer's greatest risk is not AI but taking the blame after an incident. AI can analyze risk, but accountability always falls on a person.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI but accountability and blame. When accidents occur, safety departments face immediate scrutiny. Jobs are also unevenly distributed: manufacturing and construction offer many roles, but some employers underinvest in safety and give engineers limited authority.
risks: Blame risk: first in line for accident accountability
Limited authority: some employers prioritize production over safety
Field risk: frontline work brings occupational exposure
Responsibility pressure: compliance and criminal risk coexist
Industry cycles: demand responds to investment cycles

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can calculate which production line has the highest risk coefficient, but it cannot ensure a hazard is corrected today or persuade a plant team to cooperate. That field-level ability to drive change remains human.

responsibilities: Conduct field inspections and identify risks
Develop safety measures and drive corrections
Organize training, drills, and accident investigations
skills: AI risk analysis and data tools

career_risk_cards.callout: 安全工程师最大的风险不是 AI，而是「出了事要背锅」——AI 能帮你分析风险，但责任的板子永远落在人身上。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「责任与背锅」：事故一旦发生，安全部门首当其冲被追责；同时行业分布不均衡，制造业、建筑业岗位多，但部分企业安全投入意愿不足，工程师话语权有限。
risks: 背锅风险：事故追责首当其冲
话语权有限：部分企业重生产轻安全
现场风险：深入一线有职业暴露
责任压力：合规与刑事风险并存
行业波动：受投资周期影响

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能算出哪条产线风险系数最高，但「这条隐患今天能不能真的改掉、怎么说服车间配合」——这份现场推动力，是机器给不了的。

responsibilities: 开展现场巡检与风险辨识
制定安全措施并推动整改
组织培训演练与事故调查
skills: AI 风险分析与数据工具

career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「自动化 + 编制」——类案检索与文书初稿被 AI 提速，且法院编制有限；同时 AI 让基础检索门槛骤降。

skills: Hand and foot care and pedicures

career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「职业健康与竞争分化」——长期低头弯腰、吸入粉尘胶味伤身，入门门槛低导致低价竞争，但技术好、会设计的资深美甲师仍然稀缺。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but knowing only layout and not alignment. Drawings will become digital, while alignment, assembly, commissioning, and emergency response withstand substitution.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk in this occupation is not AI but safety incidents + schedule pressure. Lifting, hot work, and work at height carry significant risks, while installation schedules are tight and standards high. AI is taking over drawing refinement and construction scheduling, but field alignment, assembly, commissioning, and emergency response still depend on people, making experienced millwrights more sought after.

Tight schedules and high standards create substantial pressure
AI takes over drawing schedules, reducing pure layout roles
Frequent travel between project sites
Physical strain from long-term heavy labor

Connect power and commission through test runs

career_path_block.路径: Special education research and curriculum development

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but permanent-position availability and administration. Tools can accelerate routine tasks, while people who understand children become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk in this occupation is not AI but volatility in permanent positions and funding plus administrative burdens. Mainstreaming policies create demand, but reporting and assessment pressures are also substantial.
risks: Volatile permanent positions and funding
Heavy administrative burdens
Emotional strain
Unequal inclusion resources
Gaps in parental expectations

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent tools become, special education teachers still use their minds to understand children, their empathy to shape plans, and their voices to communicate with parents. People cannot be fully removed from education.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「编制与行政」——事务可被工具加速，但读懂孩子的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「编制与经费波动 + 行政负担」——随班就读政策推进带来需求，但填报与考核压力也重。
risks: 编制经费波动
行政负担重
情绪消耗
融合资源不均
家长期望落差

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管工具多聪明，孩子怎么读、计划怎么定、家长怎么聊，最后还是特教老师的脑去想、心去共、嘴去讲——育人这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but instructional support tools. Grading is taken over, while assistants who guide and observe students become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI, but instructional support tools. AI accelerates grading and lesson-material generation, but classroom order and grade-appropriate tutoring still require people.
risks: Grading replaced by AI
Automated courseware generation
Automated attendance
Automated exercise generation
Administrative roles are moving elsewhere

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent tools become, assistants still observe which child is distracted today, identify where a student is stuck, explain the problem, and provide emotional reassurance. Humans cannot be fully removed from classrooms.

responsibilities: Prepare teaching aids and lesson materials

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是教学辅助工具——批改被接管，会带人观察的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 最大的风险不是 AI，而是教学辅助工具——批改和课件生成被 AI 加速，但课堂秩序与分学段辅导仍要人。
risks: 批改被 AI 替
课件自动生成
考勤自动化
练习自动出
事务岗外流

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管工具多聪明，哪个孩子今天走神、哪道题卡住、怎么安抚情绪，最后还是助理的眼去观察、嘴去说、手去带——课堂这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.说明: Most easily replaced by intelligent cutting tables
Stable demand for CAD marker planning
Depends on management experience and quality-control ability
Hybrid talent who repair equipment are scarce

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest risk in cutting work is not AI robots, but equipment advancing faster than skills. People who set up machines and plan markers are increasingly sought after, while button-only workers face growing difficulty.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI, but automated equipment upgrades. Intelligent cutting tables and automated marker-planning software reduce ordinary operator jobs, while machine setup, fault handling, and special-fabric cutting still depend on skilled workers.
risks: Equipment iteration: Intelligent cutting tables replace pure operator roles
Workshop environment: Noise and airborne fibers affect health
Income variability: Piece-rate pay fluctuates by season
Career ceiling: Pure operators have narrow advancement paths
Order relocation: Textile production capacity moves overseas

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can optimize marker layouts to the limit, but the hands beside the cutting table still provide the immediate response needed to change materials, monitor blades, and save an entire batch of fabric. People will remain necessary in the short term.

responsibilities: Set up and operate cutting tables to complete cutting
Change blades and fabric rolls and resolve exceptions

career_path_block.说明: 最容易被智能裁床替代
靠管理经验与把关能力
会修设备的复合人才稀缺

career_risk_cards.callout: 裁切岗最大的风险不是 AI 机器人，而是「设备在升级、技能没跟上」——会调机排料的人越来越抢手，只会按键的人越来越难。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「自动化设备升级」——智能裁床和自动排料软件正在压缩普通操作工的岗位，但调机、故障处理和特殊面料裁剪仍依赖熟练工。
risks: 设备迭代：纯操作岗被智能裁床替代
车间环境：噪音、飞絮影响身体
收入弹性：计件淡旺季波动大
职业天花板：纯操作工晋升通道窄
订单外流：纺织产能向海外转移

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能把排料算到极致，但裁床边上那双手的临场反应——换料、盯刀、救回一整批布，这份活儿短期还得靠人。

responsibilities: 设置并操作裁床完成裁切
更换刀具卷料并处理异常

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risks are automation and volatility. Systems absorb dispatch while cargo volumes continue to swing sharply.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risks are automation and volatility. TMS/WMS and autonomous-driving pilots absorb substantial dispatch work, while people remain essential for network design and exception decisions. E-commerce volatility and labor shortages also have major effects.
risks: Systems replace routine dispatch
E-commerce volatility has a large impact
Labor shortages make hiring difficult
Peak warehouse overload creates heavy pressure
Strict cost performance targets

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent systems become, managers still use their own system-wide judgment, coordination, and authority to decide which line is overloaded and whether to add vehicles. People cannot be removed completely from logistics.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「自动化 + 波动」——调度被系统吃，货量还忽高忽低。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「自动化 + 波动」——TMS/WMS 与自动驾驶试点吃掉大量调度，但网络设计与异常决策仍靠人；同时电商波动与用工紧张影响大。
risks: 常规调度被系统替
电商波动影响大
用工紧张招人难
高峰爆仓压力大
成本考核严

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，那条线爆仓、是不是该加车，最后还是经理的眼去看全局、嘴去协调、手去拍板——物流这头，人撤不干净。
